about: Cold-path timings and known-good validation sweeps on the other benchmark mods (decision M-6), and the Chaos Redux sweeps. Workshop mods are read where Steam installed them.

cases.title: The first overview of ZIN answers within 2 seconds
cases.evidence: Target from the plan for workspaces of Chaos Redux size; recorded here to show how the cold path scales.

cases.title: ZIN events files raise no validation errors that the game does not report
cases.evidence: A sample of the mod's events files. Every error found was checked by hand against the game's documentation, vanilla usage and error.log; files with a confirmed real error are excluded with the reason.

cases.title: A literal "undefined" event description is found
cases.evidence: events/zin_glo.txt:189 has desc = undefined, and no language defines a key named undefined.

cases.title: Files shipped empty to blank a vanilla file raise no header problem
cases.evidence: 84 Kaiserreich files, such as localisation/english/Juno_bop_l_english.yml, hold only a byte order mark (3 bytes) to blank the vanilla file of that name.

cases.title: Modifiers built from sub-units, categories and buildings are not reported as unknown
cases.evidence: Kaiserreich uses modifier_army_sub_unit_category_mobile_infantry_attack_factor and state_production_speed_infrastructure_factor, which the game builds from its unit categories and buildings.

cases.title: An idea picture no .gfx file defines is found
cases.evidence: common/ideas/PLS_ideas.txt:435 PLS_developing_weapons uses picture = generic_ammo; no loaded .gfx defines GFX_idea_generic_ammo (Old World Blues defines only GFX_goal_generic_ammo_box).
